-- Add compose_config to course, lesson, and task with seed defaults
BEGIN;

ALTER TABLE course
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS compose_config jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb;

ALTER TABLE lesson
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS compose_config jsonb NULL;

ALTER TABLE task
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS compose_config jsonb NULL;

-- Minimal docker-compose snippet used as default for seeded data
WITH compose_defaults AS (
    SELECT $${
      "version": "3.9",
      "services": {
        "app": {
          "image": "alpine:3.20",
          "command": ["sh", "-c", "while true; do sleep 3600; done"]
        }
      }
    }$$::jsonb AS cfg
)
UPDATE course
SET compose_config = cd.cfg
FROM compose_defaults cd
WHERE compose_config IS NULL OR compose_config = '{}'::jsonb;

-- Lessons and tasks from seeds get the same minimal config if missing
WITH compose_defaults AS (
    SELECT $${
      "version": "3.9",
      "services": {
        "app": {
          "image": "alpine:3.20",
          "command": ["sh", "-c", "while true; do sleep 3600; done"]
        }
      }
    }$$::jsonb AS cfg
)
UPDATE lesson
SET compose_config = cd.cfg
FROM compose_defaults cd
WHERE compose_config IS NULL;

WITH compose_defaults AS (
    SELECT $${
      "version": "3.9",
      "services": {
        "app": {
          "image": "alpine:3.20",
          "command": ["sh", "-c", "while true; do sleep 3600; done"]
        }
      }
    }$$::jsonb AS cfg
)
UPDATE task
SET compose_config = cd.cfg
FROM compose_defaults cd
WHERE compose_config IS NULL;

COMMIT;
